## 9. Podcast Highlights
- 2026-04-15 | [Harness Engineering 101](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OTjZBjq5FPg) | The core topic was “harness engineering”: the surrounding system for context, memory, safe execution, orchestration, observability, and verification around a model. Available now: yes, as an engineering pattern rather than a standalone product. How to use it: define a narrow task harness, attach only the tools and files needed, add execution boundaries, log model actions, and require verification before side effects. Why it matters: it shifts operational focus from prompt quality alone to the control plane that determines whether agent systems are reliable in production.
